settings.name: Isabelle Morel
settings.bio: Trained under the great houses of Grasse, Isabelle founded the atelier in 1998 after fifteen years in haute parfumerie. Her philosophy: a fragrance must tell a story.

settings.name: Henri Beaumont
settings.bio: A graduate of ISIPCA Versailles, Henri specialises in Oriental and Woody compositions. He oversees our flagship collection development.

settings.name: Amara Singh
settings.bio: Amara travels the world sourcing our most precious ingredients, maintaining relationships with growers in over 20 countries.
